name: Tomographic Image Synthesis for Layered 3D
aliases: Tomographic Image Synthesis for Multi-Layer HDR Displays
definition: A method to optimally construct volumetric or layered attenuators to emit a target light field by minimizing the difference between emitted and target light fields subject to physical constraints on attenuation, using iterative tomographic reconstruction.
summary: Tomographic Image Synthesis for Layered 3D is a constrained optimization method that computes optimal attenuation maps for multi-layer displays to emit target light fields, avoiding the blurring of heuristic approaches.
